versions.changelog:
gmgn-cooking v1.2.8 changelog

- Updated documentation for supported launchpads and chains (added Klik, Clanker, clarified current support).
- Adjusted details for the `--slippage` parameter: now integer 0–100, e.g. `30` = 30%.
- Expanded/updated launchpad-specific options including `--raised-token` field and quote token conversion rules.
- Revised async status polling info: token address now found under `report.output_token` in order status.
- Increased default API rate limits to `rate=20` and `capacity=20`.
- Removed skill-card.md file (docs/metadata cleanup).

gmgn-cooking v1.2.7

- Updated description for clarity and conciseness (shortened and reorganized main skill summary).
- Improved wording to cover both meme coins and crypto tokens, emphasizing use cases and supported platforms.
- No functional or CLI changes; documentation only.
- No file changes detected in this version.

gmgn-cooking v1.2.6

- Updated description for improved clarity and broader examples (now mentions Raydium, ETH, TON).
- No file or functional code changes detected in this release.
- No changes to usage, commands, or features. Documentation only.

gmgn-cooking v1.2.5

- Major documentation overhaul in SKILL.md for clarity and safe usage.
- Added explicit workflow, credential, and security instructions for irreversible on-chain actions.
- Expanded platform mapping and validated all launchpad/DEX identifiers per chain.
- Strengthened instructions on error handling (IPv6, rate limits, credential shadowing).
- Improved user and agent safety guidance, requiring explicit confirmation before any transaction.
- Provided detailed CLI usage patterns and prerequisites for setup and execution.
